title: Abdominal CT with organ labels
what_it_shows: A 2x2 of an abdominal CT in a soft-tissue window (W400/L40) with the 15 AMOS organ labels filled at 0.55, the crosshair driving all three planes, and the organs as marching-cubes surfaces in the 3D pane.
dataset: AMOS22 CT `amos_0004` — abdominal CT, 0.78 x 0.78 x 5 mm, with the 15-organ label map (CC-BY-4.0)

title: A simulated field in the brain
what_it_shows: The TI_max field of a thalamic montage, thresholded at its own 90th percentile with the scale running p90 -> p97 -> p99.9: in the big 3D pane of a 1+3 layout the field on grey_Thalamus_TI.msh inside a translucent grey-matter surface, seen 30 degrees off left-lateral; in the slice panes the same field as a localised heat overlay on the T1. One colour bar.
dataset: ernie — Simulations/Thalamus/TI (Thalamus_TI.msh + grey_Thalamus_TI.msh + grey_Thalamus_TI_subject_TI_max.nii.gz) over T1.nii.gz

title: Chest CT with per-vertebra labels
what_it_shows: A 2x2 of a chest CT in a bone window (W1500/L300) with every vertebra separately labelled, and the whole labelled column rebuilt as one surface per vertebra in the 3D pane.
dataset: CTSpine1K / COVID-19 `A-0377` — chest CT, 0.74 x 0.74 x 5 mm, every vertebra labelled (CC-BY-NC-SA)

title: T1, four panes
what_it_shows: The subject's T1 in the 2x2 layout: axial, coronal and sagittal slices through one crosshair, and the three planes standing in the 3D pane.

title: T1 with the left pial surface
what_it_shows: lh.pial.gii as a green contour wherever it crosses a slice, and the surface itself among the T1's planes in the 3D pane.

title: T1 with both pial surfaces
what_it_shows: Left and right pial surfaces as contours in the slice panes (green and yellow), and both hemispheres in 3D, seen from the left with the axial plane cut below them.

title: The thalamus, soloed
what_it_shows: The labeling atlas reduced to the left and right thalamus (ids 10 and 49) filled at full opacity over the T1, and the same region as a 3D surface between the slice planes, close up.

title: EEG electrodes on the T1
what_it_shows: A 185-channel HydroCel net read from a Gmsh .geo view: labelled spheres wherever an electrode sits on a slice, and the whole net over the head in 3D.

title: Tissue segmentation with the head mesh
what_it_shows: final_tissues.nii.gz filled at full opacity in its SimNIBS LUT colours, 2x2, with the head mesh's scalp surface alone in the 3D pane.

title: Skull through a translucent scalp
what_it_shows: ernie.msh in 3D with the scalp at low opacity over the opaque skull, eyes and the paranasal sinuses, from an anterior-oblique camera.

title: A tDCS field on the whole head mesh
what_it_shows: |E| of a tDCS simulation painted on every tissue of the head mesh: the 2D cuts filled by the field with the tissue boundaries outlined, and the scalp in 3D showing the two electrodes as the hot spots.

title: TI_max on the grey matter
what_it_shows: The grey-matter mesh of a thalamic TI montage coloured by TI_max on a jet scale from 0.01 to 0.2 V/m: the cortex cut by the three slices in 2D and the whole surface in 3D, one colour bar.

title: The E vector field as glyphs
what_it_shows: The tDCS mesh with its tissues in flat colours in the slice panes, and in the 3D pane the E field as arrows coloured by magnitude and log-scaled in length, over a translucent scalp.

title: E-field glyphs, 3D alone
what_it_shows: The same glyphs filling a single 3D pane from the left: the field radiating from the two electrodes, red near them and blue deep in the head.
